title: nephrodium pandum
intro: Nephrodium pandum, commonly known as the Maidenhair fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. The Maidenhair fern is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is believed to help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Nephrodium pandum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of the Maidenhair fern also exhibit antioxidant and free radical scavenging activities, which may contribute to its protective effects against oxidative stress and cell damage.
